sentences.en: The congressional staffer who leaked classified documents has been arrested.
sentences.zh: 泄露机密文件的国会工作人员已被逮捕。

sentences.en: The senator was censured by the congressional ethics committee.
sentences.zh: 参议员被国会道德委员会谴责。

sentences.en: The Congressional Medal of Honor is the highest award that any soldier can aspire to.
sentences.zh: 国会对卓越服役勋章是任何士兵所能企及的最高荣誉。
